**Settled:** the one-step save, and the set of details shown. ✓

**Applied:** every item now shows a real page thumbnail and the site's icon (in this prototype those images are realistic stand-ins I generate locally — a prototype can't reach out to live pages — but in the real app they'll come from the actual page, exactly as you asked).

**Your duplicate request** — pasting a link you've already saved shouldn't create a copy; it should take you to the existing one to update — I've noted it and we'll do it in the very next step. I'm holding it one round so we settle just one thing at a time.

---

**Right now, let's settle how you correct a wrong title or description.** There are a few genuinely different ways this can feel, so I've set up three versions that are identical except for that one thing. Each already has the NASA bookmark saved, and its auto-filled title is deliberately a bit clunky — *"NASA's James Webb Space Telescope | Home — NASA"* — so you have something real to fix.

In **each** version, please do the same thing: **shorten that title to just "James Webb Space Telescope"**, and notice how the correction feels.

- **Option A — quick save, fix later with a button:** http://maker:4001/edit-a.html
  Click the item's **Edit** button, change the title, Save changes.

- **Option B — quick check before it's saved:** http://maker:4001/edit-b.html
  Here correcting happens *while saving*. Paste a new link (e.g. `https://developer.mozilla.org/css-grid`), press Save, and you'll get a short editable preview to fix the title *before* it's added.

- **Option C — quick save, tap the text to edit:** http://maker:4001/edit-c.html
  Click **directly on the title text** on the item, edit it in place, click away.

The key trade-off to feel: A and C keep every save a single tap and let you fix things only when needed; B checks details on every save (safer, but one extra step each time — which trades against the "effortless" feeling you care about).

**After trying them, tell me which correction style fits you best — and whether it should be that way both when saving and later.**
